description: Read every barcode in a PNG, JPEG or WebP image, given as base64 (or a data URL), a public https URL, or an attached file. At most 2 MB and 4000 by 4000 pixels. Returns text, format, corner positions and GS1 product number, expiry and lot when present.

file.description: An image file the user attached (OpenAI Apps SDK file parameter).

image.description: Base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP or image data URL; 2 MB decoded maximum. Give one of image, url or file.

url.description: Public https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image; 2 MB maximum.

name: read_barcode
title: Barcode scanner
